model_output.verdict: An ICU nurse with clear bedside experience, plus charge and committee work that needs a little more detail.
write_up: Your resume tells a clear story from telemetry at Saguaro Community Hospital to the medical ICU at Desert Valley Medical Center. A recruiter can see the patients and treatments you handle, so I’d expect this resume to move forward for an ICU staff nurse role with a couple of questions.

Your line about caring for 2 critically ill patients per shift in a 24-bed medical ICU is a strong model: it names the patients, your care and the setting. Your Arizona license and CCRN are easy to find above your experience, and your education follows your nursing roles.

Let’s add a little more about what you do as charge nurse and on the sepsis committee. Those details can show how your work extends beyond your own patient assignment without taking attention away from bedside care.

cards.line: - Provide direct care for 2 critically ill patients per shift in a 24-bed medical ICU
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this line. It gives a recruiter the patient assignment and the unit context together, without making them guess.

cards.line: - Serve as charge nurse two shifts per month
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see how often you take charge, but not what you're responsible for during those shifts. Your duties would show what that role involves on your unit.
cards.example: Serve as charge nurse two shifts per month, with responsibility for [charge nurse responsibilities]
cards.question: What are you responsible for when you serve as charge nurse?

cards.cannot_tell: Committee membership tells a recruiter where you participate, but not what you do there. Name your contribution if you can.
